required_fixes: FIX-HARNESS-NGINX-CONFIG (root cause of this run): generate one `location /` block per server in `_write_nginx_conf` (run_experiment.py lines 209-235 write TWO `location /` blocks). Empirically verified with nginx 1.24.0: `nginx -t` fails with `[emerg] duplicate location "/"`; removing the duplicate makes the config parse successfully. This deterministically prevented nginx from starting on :19851 and is the proximate cause of HEALTH_GATE_FAILED. Any re-run without this fix fails identically before Phase 1.

FIX-AUTH-VALIDATION: implement real PyJWT verification at the origin. No endpoint in create_app() (nor in the app_factory.py template) calls jwt.decode on the Authorization header; /api/profile and /api/data_list return 200 regardless of token validity. The producer metric `freshness_hs256_valid_success_rate` (counts `use_valid and status==200`, run_experiment.py:481) is therefore tautological, and the frozen TN/FA/ECE/bc indicators are uncomputable. The frozen PC-304-REAL gate (hs256_valid_success>=0.90 via PyJWT decode, not raw Bearer lookup) cannot pass.

FIX-PRIMARY-METRICS: compute TN=P(bc<=0.05|valid), FA, ECE<=0.15, Wilson lower bound and the frozen TOST delta=0.15 Fisher-z test. wilson_ci() and fisher_z_ci() are defined (lines 172-182) but never called; no TOST, no ECE, no bc computation exists anywhere in the executed path; C1-FRESHNESS checks only n_non304 and hs_rate.

FIX-HEADER-ONLY-JACCARD-SYNTHETIC: Phase 2 fabricates hdr1/hdr2 dicts from a body_state->Cache-Control mapping (run_experiment.py:536-539) instead of computing header-only Jaccard MINUS {Content-Length,ETag,W-ETag,Content-Range} on REAL response headers; raw observations never store response headers. Also restore the frozen TOST equivalence structure (stratified |r|<0.15, CI upper<0.15, pooled |r|<0.15, 8/8 variance FP<=0.15); the executed C3 checks a different quantity (scheduling r vs V<0.30 only).

FIX-HONEST-COST: Phase 3 fabricates honest_cost = rng.randint(5,15) per trajectory (run_experiment.py:585); the frozen count_resolve+count_bind+count_verify+count_freshness+count_browser_steps counters are never defined or incremented, and per-observation honest_cost is hardcoded 0 (line 484). Run the trajectory-grouped permutation with B=5000 (code uses 500 shuffles, line 591) on real per-trajectory sums; within-f std, CI width and effective>1 must come from actual data.

FIX-HIT-MATRIX: Phase 4 uses 8 synthetic test_cells (line 624) instead of the frozen 48-cell x5-rep (~330) two-phase populate-vs-test matrix with raw_body_sha256/Content-Encoding/X-Cache; the C6 pass clause `(total_identity == 0 or hit_identity >= total_identity*0.9)` (line 661) passes vacuously when nothing is measured, and the greedy denominator is len(test_cells) even when requests fail.

FIX-BROWSER-PHASE: N=2 pages (range(2), line 676) not frozen N=20 per state; C8-BROWSER-DISCRIM pass is hardcoded ('full=1.0, status=0.0, headers=0.0, gradient_widths=[0.5,0.8]', line 718) with zero B=1000 bootstraps; effective_distinct_n reduces to '2 body variants differ'; DOM21-82 check is vacuous (`or dom_count_median > 10`, line 705); browser.close() is called twice (lines 692-693). Align Playwright to the frozen 1.63.0 (environment has 1.44.0, provenance line 12) or amend the frozen spec before claiming C7/C8.

FIX-FACTORY-PATTERN-GREP-GATE: the executed gunicorn entrypoint is `wsgi:application` (line 325) importing app_factory.py containing module-level `application = create_app()` (line 313). The frozen validity gate requires grep-verified factory-only WSGI ('run_experiment:create_app()' or lazy init in wsgi.py). provenance.json `factory_pattern_wsgi: true` (line 35) is therefore misleading and must not be asserted until the executed entrypoint complies.

FIX-PROVENANCE-AND-NULL-REPORTING: provenance hardcodes playwright version and browser_gym_installed/agentlab_installed (lines 817-826); artifact sha256 fields in result.json are null despite files existing; the zero-placeholder observation strings ('Header-only scheduling r=0.0000', 'Honest |rho_shuffled|=0.0000') could be misread as measurements — report such values as explicitly not-measured (null), not numeric zeros.

validity_findings.finding: HEALTH_GATE_FAILED is a deterministic harness bug, not an environment flake: `_write_nginx_conf` emits two `location /` blocks in the same server context (run_experiment.py:209-235). Reproduced empirically with nginx 1.24.0 on this runner: `nginx -t` -> `[emerg] duplicate location "/"` (config test failed, exit 1); with the duplicate removed the same config passes `nginx -t`. nginx therefore never listened on 127.0.0.1:19851, so `_health_gate(15)` correctly timed out/refused and the run aborted at Phase 0 with 0 observations. Producer status MEASUREMENT_INVALID and outcome INCONCLUSIVE are the correct classification; this is infrastructure/harness failure, not scientific falsification (EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md s1/s9).

validity_findings.finding: The Flask application performs no token validation: no jwt.decode call exists in create_app() or app_factory.py. `valid` vs `expired` distinctions exist only client-side (run_experiment.py:447-472). The frozen positive control PC-304-REAL (real PyJWT HS256 verification, hs256_valid_success>=0.90, 304 semantics gated on actual session/auth state) is not implemented; any TN/FA derived from this harness would be tautological.

TN, FA, ECE, Wilson lower bound, and the TOST equivalence test are never computed: wilson_ci() and fisher_z_ci() are defined but never invoked; the only 'TN' string in the code is the control 'expected' text (line 512). Even if the health gate had passed, C1-C4 as frozen (TN>=0.85 Wilson lo>0.75 FA<=0.10 ECE<=0.15; TOST p_upper<0.05 CI upper<0.15 pooled |r|<0.15 8/8 variance FP<=0.15) could not have been reported from this code.

Phase 2 computes header-only Jaccard from hand-built hdr1/hdr2 dictionaries derived from body_state (Cache-Control mapping, lines 536-539), not from real HTTP response headers; no response headers are stored in raw_freshness_observations (line 482-484). The frozen requirement (real filtered headers MINUS body-derived, preserving Cache-Control/Set-Cookie/Vary, de-confounded scheduling) is not measurable from this code. Also, the C3 control actually checks the scheduling confound (r<0.30, V<0.30), a different object than the frozen C3 TOST orthogonality test.

Phase 3 honest_cost per trajectory is rng.randint(5,15) (line 585), independent of any real operation; the frozen sum counter (resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser_steps, once per real op per trajectory_id) is never implemented; the permutation null uses 500 shuffles, not the frozen B=5000 (line 591); within-f std/CI width/effective are computed on random integers. A run reaching Phase 3 would produce |rho_shuffled|~0 by construction (noise), which is precisely the kind of artifact NC-COST-SHUFFLED and the frozen validity gates exist to exclude.

Phase 4 defines only 8 test cells (line 624) versus the frozen 48 cells x 5 reps (~330 raw_hit_observations required); the C6 pass clause passes vacuously when total_identity==0 (line 661), and greedy_correct is divided by len(test_cells) regardless of whether requests succeeded. Stale HIT/SWR/SIE/304 branches are absent. A 'successful' HIT phase could not satisfy the frozen 330/330 + oracle-free >=90% + 0 ambiguous claim.
